This millet plot is small, only 0.36 hectare, and I intercrop to spread risk. I have no schooling but I know millet needs the soil to be kept alive — I will carry manure from our animals onto the plot before planting. I can afford a small bag of fertilizer through the subsidy, so I will apply a little urea at weeding time, but not much, since millet here does not need as much as maize. I will save my own seed from last year as my mother taught me, and my family will do the weeding ourselves — hiring labor is too costly for a plot this size.
